text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month, nine-month, 12-month and 18-month treasury bills edged down from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Thursday.

Six-month bills eased to 20.03 percent from 20.05 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 26.61 percent from 26.98 percent, 12-month bills fell to 26.61 percent from 26.98 percent, and 18-month bills skimmed to 31.97 from 32.17 percent.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 12.40 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 2.54 million UAH 136.18 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.31 million UAH 123.80 million UAH
The central bank sold 25,372 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for August 5.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 33.00 million UAH 10.90 million UAH
Amount sold 33.00 million UAH 10.90 million UAH
Actual amount raised 27.52 million UAH 9.07 million UAH
The central bank sold 330,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for August 5.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 74.00 million UAH 32.30 million UAH
Amount sold 74.00 million UAH 32.30 million UAH
Actual amount raised 58.06 million UAH 25.15 million UAH
The central bank sold 740,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for August 5.
The results of the 18-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 154.14 million UAH 75.03 million UAH
Actual amount raised 104.28 million UAH 50.65 million UAH
The central bank sold 1,541,456 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 18-month discount T-bills is scheduled for August 5.
